root_cause: Powerhouse predictive delivery had no bounded per-job provider timestamp baseline; single build samples and total queued counts cannot support truthful p50/p95 optimization or root cause attribution.
failed_approaches: Treat one build phase profile as p95
Conflate historical zero-job provider ghosts with genuine runner wait
Treat missing/partial API reads as zero queue time
Start extra recurring CI checkers just to collect statistics
Fixed 12-run sampling produced only 17 valid jobs and could not satisfy the 20-job threshold even though the provider reads succeeded.
fix: Use the existing hourly Repository Janitor to read up to 12 completed workflow runs and their job timestamps, writing only a provenance-tagged observation artifact. Compute percentiles only after at least 20 complete jobs from 5 distinct runs, preserving identity and incomplete observations. Follow-up adaptation: query at most 24 runs only as needed and stop early when 20 valid jobs from 5 runs exist with no provider read errors; preserve partial evidence boundaries. Subsequent bounded fail-fast follow-up: stop the current read cycle immediately after the first malformed or denied job-list response, retain the read error and suppress all percentiles; no repeated provider reads once trust is lost.
prevention_rule: No CI speedup, performance SLO, green status or autonomous workflow optimization from partial, small or provider-denied telemetry. Read-only collection cannot start/cancel/approve work, lower security gates, waive branch protection, change runner resources or spend. Job timings are diagnostic metrics, not deployment frequency or change lead time. Explicitly preserve unresolved provider-ghost issue #4655. Every sample is independently counted; do not lower the 20-job / 5-run threshold. Once it is met without read errors, stop extra GitHub GETs to reduce API pressure; the first incomplete or denied provider read stops the sweep immediately, records partial evidence, and suppresses all percentiles; further GETs cannot restore completeness for that observation.

invariants: 20 complete jobs and 5 distinct attempts needed for percentiles
limited 24-run API read fanout with adaptive early-stop
no automatic workflow mutation or skip of protected CI checks
adaptive read stops immediately after verified minimum rather than a fixed under-sampling window
24-run hard budget; partial provider read cannot be masked by later successful jobs
first real 12-run sample 17 jobs remains honestly INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
first malformed or denied jobs read stops the current cycle without further GitHub GETs; partial statistics remain NULL
Completed Required pull_request run identity must match its encoded #PR and exact 40-character head SHA; matrix jobs, workflow_dispatch and merge_group are not extra candidate heads.
One PR multiple full checks on same commit is one candidate head; malformed provider evidence holds all PR-head churn claims.
No automatic queue settings, bypassed CodeQL, or claimed causal speedup from a truncated sample.
The workflow-scoped Required history is separately available or HOLD, never inferred as empty from a generic page full of unrelated runs.
One additional bounded provider history GET and unchanged <=24 job-list GETs; targeted read failure must not fake or contaminate separate job latency percentiles.

terminal_rule: This observation step is live only after exact-head Required, hygiene, CodeQL, protected merge, actual hourly Janitor execution artifact and main/readback + skill projection. No claim of speed improvement without repeated comparable baselines, and #4661 remains broader open.
dependencies: adaptive source must pass protected CI and a second real Janitor observation before any runtime metric proof can be claimed

followup_provider_failfast_20261023.safe_change: Immediately stop on first provider read failure or incomplete jobs pagination, preserve partial status and evidence; never claim valid sample, live deployment or sustained speedup on test-only evidence.
